description: Add bid modifiers. Each must include CampaignId or AdGroupId and an adjustment object. Use when the user asks to add a new bid adjustment. Do not use it to change an existing adjustment; call set_bid_modifiers, which spends money and requires confirm. Do not use it to list them; call get_bid_modifiers.

items_json.description: JSON array of bid modifier objects, e.g. [{"CampaignId":12345,"MobileAdjustment":{"BidModifier":50}}]

name: add_bid_modifiers
